data.title: Kitchen Mystery pH Lab
data.description: Discover the hidden properties of everyday liquids using colorful testing paper!

substances.name: Lemon Juice
substances.realWorldInfo: Lemon juice makes your mouth pucker because it is packed with sour flavor and natural juice!

substances.name: Vinegar
substances.realWorldInfo: Vinegar is often used to give potato chips a tangy punch and helps make pickles crunchy.

substances.name: Orange Juice
substances.realWorldInfo: Drinking orange juice is a popular way to get a big boost of vitamin C in the morning.

substances.name: Pure Water
substances.realWorldInfo: Pure water is totally balanced and makes up over half of the human body!

substances.name: Baking Soda Solution
substances.realWorldInfo: Baking soda helps fluffy cakes rise high when they bake in a hot oven.

substances.name: Hand Soap
substances.realWorldInfo: Soap helps trap greasy dirt in bubbles so it can easily wash down the drain with water.

substances.name: Milk of Magnesia
substances.realWorldInfo: Despite its milky name, this liquid is used in medicine cabinets to help soothe tummy aches.
